job: FIXTURE - Riverside House as it stood on 27/07/2026
_note: The founding case for check_free_delivery_threshold and for the thin-margin arm of check_quote_validity_against_commitment. Real figures. A Plus QT51518 is GBP 4,845.22 - GBP 154.78 under A Plus's own GBP 5,000 ex VAT free-delivery threshold - while the quote's Job Spec line reads 'Glazed /Supply Only (Delivered)'. And it expires 26/08/2026, the exact day Fenster's own 30-day validity closes, so it passes 'held as long as ours' with zero headroom. Only price_commitment, supplier_quotes and delivery_terms are populated - this fixture exists to prove TWO rules fire.

price_commitment.source: Private client, no ITT and no Form of Tender. Fenster house validity 30 days, pricing document dated 27/07/2026.
price_commitment.note: Submission is gated by PHDB returning building-works costs, so issue will be later than 27/07 and the headroom goes negative.
